name: slg1.0
description: King of World (KOW) - 全栈TypeScript网页SLG

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint -w @slg/server && npm run lint -w @slg/client
scripts.test:all: npm run test:server && npm run test -w @slg/client
scripts.verify:quick: npm run build:shared && npm run lint:all && npm run typecheck && npm run test:all
scripts.verify:deploy: npm run build && npm run test:deploy
scripts.verify: npm run guard && npm run verify:quick && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
